_comment: Master Mobile Plan (2026) > Recovery Measures > Recovery: Offline Reinstall and Update App > 'Recovery (offline) 2' - 'Ensure Test Two released, Test Three in-test'. This is the offline-workflow's app (a separate HQ app from the plain 'Reinstall and Update App' app used by reinstall_update_2_mark_test_two.json - see offline_reinstall_update_app_flow.yaml's header for why MEASURE_TYPE_APP_OFFLINE_REINSTALL_AND_UPDATE is a distinct code path). 'Ensure ... released' (rather than 'Mark ... released') implies this may already be true from a prior cycle - mark_build_status is idempotent (POSTing is_released=true to an already-released build is a no-op per release_build()'s source), so this is safe to run either way. create_new_build cuts the Test Three build and leaves it in the default in-test (unreleased) state, satisfying 'Test Three in-test'. app_id/saved_app_id values are placeholders - Recovery Measures apps get rebuilt each QA cycle per the sheet's own 'Dimagi must reconfigure setup here prior to each run' note, so fill these in fresh every run.
